description: Query the market order list with paging (`offset`, `limit` ≤ 10). Returns `{ orders: [{ id, requester?.address, receiver.address, resourceType, resourceAmount, remainAmount, durationSec, unitPrice (SUN), isOwner, isMatching, apy, createdAt, typeOrder (NORMAL|FAST|EXTEND) }] }`. `status`: `ACTIVE` = still matching, `COMPLETED` = no longer matching. Set `isOnlyMyOrder=true` (requires a wallet signature identity) to list orders requested by the caller's wallet. Use `tronsave_get_order` with an `id` for one snapshot before mutating an order.

isOnlyMyOrder.description: When `true`, only orders requested by the wallet of the current signature identity (signature login or `Signature` header). Api-key-only sessions cannot use this filter.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return in one call. Prefer modest limits to avoid huge payloads; page with `offset`.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset for page N (skip first `offset` matches). Omit when starting from the first page.

resourceType.description: Restrict to `ENERGY` or `BANDWIDTH` orders; omit for both.

status.description: Lifecycle filter: `ACTIVE` = still matching/open, `COMPLETED` = no longer matching. Omit for both.
